description: Implementation of Win32Waiter class for Windows synchronization primitives, including lock management, waiting with timeout, and condition variable signaling.

classes.name: WinHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods to access internal lock and condition variable storage within Win32Waiter.

classes.name: LockHolder
classes.description: RAII class for acquiring and releasing SRWLOCKs.

methods.name: Win32Waiter::Win32Waiter
methods.description: Constructor initializing SRWLOCK and CONDITION_VARIABLE, setting counters to zero.

methods.name: Win32Waiter::Wait
methods.description: Waits on the condition variable with optional timeout, handling wakeups and errors.

methods.name: Win32Waiter::Post
methods.description: Signals one waiting thread via condition variable.

methods.name: Win32Waiter::Poke
methods.description: Signals waiting threads without changing counters.

methods.name: Win32Waiter::InternalCondVarPoke
methods.description: Internal method to wake waiting threads if any are present.
